maddeler.e:
نتذبذب (form IIq)
# نَتَذَبْذَبُ (nataḏabḏabu) /na.ta.ðab.ða.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَذَبْذَبَ (taḏabḏaba)
# نَتَذَبْذَبَ (nataḏabḏaba) /na.ta.ðab.ða.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَذَبْذَبَ (taḏabḏaba)
# نَتَذَبْذَبْ (nataḏabḏab) /na.ta.ðab.ðab/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَذَبْذَبَ (taḏabḏaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
